title: mentha × niliaca var. alopecuroides
intro: Mentha × niliaca var. alopecuroides, commonly known as Woolly Mint, is a hybrid plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid in digestion, relieve nausea, and exhibit antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Mint include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. Woolly Mint contains bioactive constituents such as menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and potential health benefits.
